map.按到期收益率折现票息与面值。: Discount the coupons and face value at the yield to maturity.
map.YTM>票息 → 折价。: YTM > coupon → traded at a discount.
map.半年付息为常见。: Semiannual payments are the most common.
map.📚 深度解析：债券定价（票息+面值折现）: 📚 In-depth analysis: bond pricing (discounting coupons + face value)
map.给定票息、到期收益率、期限，算债券合理价格。: Given the coupon, yield to maturity and term, compute the fair price of the bond.
map.看收益率上升时价格怎么跌（利率风险）。: See how the price falls when the yield rises (interest rate risk).
map.已知市场要求的到期收益率，反推债券的合理成交价。: Given the yield to maturity demanded by the market, work backwards to the fair trading price of the bond.
map.P = 50×ä₁₀@6%(≈7.360) + 1000×v¹⁰(0.558): P = 50×ä₁₀@6% (≈7.360) + 1000×v¹⁰ (0.558) = 368 + 558 = 926 CNY. Since YTM > coupon, it trades at a discount.
map.面值 1000、票息率 5%、YTM 6%、期限 5 年（半年付息）: Face value 1000, coupon rate 5%, YTM 6%, term 5 years (semiannual payments)
map.页面默认 freq=2 即每年付息两次：每期票息 c=1000×5%/2=25: The page defaults to freq=2, i.e. two payments per year: each coupon c=1000×5%/2=25 CNY, each discount rate y=6%/2=3%, with T=5×2=10 periods. P=Σ25/(1.03)^t (t=1…10)+1000/(1.03)¹⁰≈957.35 CNY. The coupon rate is below YTM, so it is issued at a discount.
map.为什么价格低于面值？: Why is the price below face value?
map.市场收益率 6% 高于票息率 5%，旧债需折价才有人买；溢价/折价由 YTM 与: The market yield of 6% is higher than the 5% coupon rate, so the old bond must be discounted to attract buyers; premium or discount is determined by the gap between YTM and coupon.
map.票息率和 YTM 的关系如何决定价格？: How does the relationship between the coupon rate and YTM determine the price?
map.票息率>YTM 溢价（价格高于面值），相等则平价，小于则折价。上例票息 5%<Y: Coupon rate > YTM means a premium (price above face value), equality means par, and lower means a discount. In the example the 5% coupon < 6% YTM, so the theoretical price of 957.35 CNY is below the 1000 CNY face value. Changing freq to 1 (annual payments) gives a price of about 957.88 CNY, showing that payment frequency also affects pricing.
